mechanism: Valerian may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing primaquine metabolism and exposure, while both agents carry hepatotoxicity risk and valerian may potentiate CNS depression.
action: Monitor for increased primaquine adverse effects (hemolytic anemia in G6PD deficiency, hepatotoxicity); consider spacing administration or using alternative antimalarial if hepatic impairment present.
